release: Pupper FC appliance and perception release
installed_pi_status: Packed and not accessed. No physical boot, new homing time, torque, return to play, field dimensions or real two-team color identity claimed.

baseline.historical_timeout: Legacy driver reported stale balance data; failed component and origin of gap unknown.
baseline.later_offense: Separate attempt: camera clearance and arming problems, no accepted body motion.

design_decisions: Deterministic measured projection and frozen local snapshot. No cloud image upload.
Connect prepares when cold. Supported Home and an independent Stop gamepad are needed to stand. Warm matches reuse the healthy posture.
Physical body ID/heading uses either two body tags or asymmetric center/nose color patches. Anonymous body preview cannot command a robot.
Onboard pixels and detector mode are telemetry. Obstacle processing remains independent.
boot_and_versions: Appliance boot writes next-boot systemd settings once. Runtime has no new boot daemon or desktop. Normal mode restores prior selection; FC application rollback is separate.

timing_regression.observed: One Red second-kick cancellation with tracking_lost. Exact cause undetermined.
timing_regression.independently_reproduced: An 8 ms scheduling pause during a wall-clock sample permanently disqualified the camera despite consistent clocks.
timing_regression.fixed: Retry one bounded measurement or skip this observation. Keep original capture time and 300 ms motion evidence expiry. Real 250 ms wall step still invalidates the session.
timing_regression.checks: 51 clock, ingress and attack tests. New regression uses actual UDP publisher and Pi binding.

mac_extracted_chrome.calibrated_preview: Mapped floor tags 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 · Ball visible · Blue visible · Red visible
mac_extracted_chrome.offline_check: Synthetic field passed. Six floor tags, both robots, the ball and kickoff verified. One corner tag and both teams’ colour-patch positions and signed headings also passed.

stage.native_binaries: source-only; requires selected target-native controller, driver and gateway

robot_client.session: Observe-only real rclpy graph in network-disabled ARM64 Jazzy container. No physical processes or controller/hardware services. validate_session_manifest=False solely for isolated operator-client construction.

pi_prepare_scope: Extracted Pi app; real ARM64 ROS process cold/warm Prepare and new dashboard Connect helper; rebuilt board plus earlier ABI-compatible walking/Stop libraries and approved HEF. No SSH, devices or actuator time.

bookworm_boot_test.scope: Clean disposable Debian Bookworm ARM64 filesystem, actual systemctl and systemd-analyze condition, archived unit files. No Pi or live PID 1 reboot.

boot_regressions: 65 adapted vendor scenarios and 9 independent regressions passed. Exact aliases, condition reset, foreign files, and concurrent administrator changes were exercised.
setup_rehearsal: Real colcon board build and enrollment in an unprivileged isolated ARM64 fixture reflecting the preexisting qualified walker and separate Stop-gateway overlays. It selected the actual approved HEF, enrolled Blue then Red. Discovery/boot privilege calls and Hailo imports were substituted in this enrollment test. Boot configuration was separately verified on Debian ARM64 with real systemd.
quick_suite: 121 passed, plus 34 parametrized subtests. The extracted Mac also passed both built-in perception and kickoff checks.
ros_scope: Real ROS Jazzy and UDP field-source processes, production match director, executor, operator actions and kick handoff. Camera observations are scripted. Positions, kick completion, native guard readiness and gateway readiness are simulated in this match rehearsal. Compiled driver injection, obstacle guard and extracted-client checks are separate. Times measure the dashboard match request to a nonzero executor command on prepared peers. No physical motion measured.
rollback: Using two actual extracted archives, restored the prior enrollment/manifest/prefix and disabled a first-managed install. Privilege call and native library contents were fixtures for this procedure. Debian test separately restored the real original systemd default.
